# bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_value (Resource)

A value of a dictionary attribute definition. The value is managed in the default (`en`) context.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_definition" "country" {
  name = "Country"
}

resource "bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_value" "netherlands" {
  attribute_definition_id = bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_definition.country.id
  value                   = "Netherlands"
  number                  = "nl"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attribute_definition_id` (String) The ID of the dictionary attribute definition.
- `value` (String) The value.

### Optional

- `number` (String) The number of the value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform-generated unique identifier of the dictionary value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_value.netherlands <attribute_definition_id>/<value_id>
```
